```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(knitr)
```

# Morphometic analysis
```{r, label="import spores",results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

eco <- read_csv("Results/Ecology/Ecology_from_tree.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

pca <- read_csv("Results/PCA/PCA_Spore_Scores_Aggregated_with_Count.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

vol <- read_csv("Results/Volume/Volume.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

loc <- read_csv("Results/Weather/East_Coast_Holotypes.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

clim <- read.csv("Results/Climate/Amanita_Climate_Summary.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))


```

# data merge 
```{r}


# Merge the PCA and volume datasets
merged_data <- pca %>%
  left_join(vol, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(eco, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(loc, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(clim, by = "species")
  #mutate(PC1 = as.numeric(PC1_mean), avg_volume_estimated = as.numeric(avg_volume_estimated))

# View the merged dataset
head(merged_data)

```

# visualize merged data

```{r}

# Correlation test
cor_test_result <- cor.test(merged_data$avg_volume_estimated, merged_data$PC1_mean)
cor_coef <- round(cor_test_result$estimate, 3)   # Correlation coefficient
p_value <- signif(cor_test_result$p.value, 3)    # p-value

```



```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)

# Extract top 5 for each extreme of both axes (with ecological niche)
top_largest_volume <- merged_data %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_volume_estimated)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(category = "Largest Spore Volume")

top_smallest_volume <- merged_data %>%
  arrange(avg_volume_estimated) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(category = "Smallest Spore Volume")

top_elongate_spores <- merged_data %>%
  arrange(desc(PC1_mean)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(category = "Most Elongate Spores (High PC1)")

top_globose_spores <- merged_data %>%
  arrange(PC1_mean) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(category = "Most Globose Spores (Low PC1)")

# Combine all and remove duplicates by species
top_extremes_combined <- bind_rows(
  top_largest_volume,
  top_smallest_volume,
  top_elongate_spores,
  top_globose_spores
) %>%
  distinct(species, .keep_all = TRUE)  # Remove duplicates

# View the final list of extremes
top_extremes_combined %>%
  select(species, avg_volume_estimated, PC1_mean)

```

```{r, label="plot_extremes", echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Plot highlighting the extremes with ecological niche colors
extremes_plot <- ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = PC1_mean, y = avg_volume_estimated)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 3, shape = 16) +  # Background points
  geom_point(data = top_extremes_combined, aes( shape = category), size = 6) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = top_extremes_combined,
    aes(label = species),
    size = 5, box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = Inf,
    segment.color = "grey50", force = 2
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(15, 16, 17, 18)) +  # Different shapes per category
  labs(
    title = "Top 5 Extremes of Spore Shape and Volume",
    x = "PC1 Score (Shape Variation: Globose to Elongate)",
    y = "Estimated Spore Volume (µm³)",
    shape = "Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "top",
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )

# Display the plot
print(extremes_plot)

# Save the plot
ggsave("Top_5_Spore_Extremes_PC1_Volume_Niche.png",
       plot = extremes_plot, width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300)





```
